subject: Spanska
title: Questions and negation
sourceSummary: Question words, how questions are formed, and how to make a sentence negative.

questions.prompt: Which question word fits: "¿___ vives?" — "Vivo en Madrid."
questions.opener: The answer refers to a place.
questions.explanation: "¿Dónde vives?" means "where do you live?", and the answer "vivo en Madrid" (I live in Madrid) fits it exactly.

questions.prompt: Which question word fits: "¿___ años tienes?" — "Tengo quince años."
questions.opener: The answer is a number followed by "años".
questions.explanation: "¿Cuántos años tienes?" means "how old are you?" (literally "how many years do you have?"). "Cuántos" asks for a quantity.

questions.prompt: What does "¿Por qué no vienes a la fiesta?" ask?
questions.opener: "Por qué" (two words, with an accent) means "why".
choices: Why aren't you coming to the party?
Who is coming to the party?
questions.explanation: "¿Por qué...?" means "why...?". The sentence asks "why aren't you coming to the party?".

questions.prompt: How do you make the sentence "Como carne" (I eat meat) negative?
questions.opener: Negation in Spanish is placed directly before the verb.
questions.explanation: "No" is placed directly before the verb: "No como carne" (I don't eat meat).

questions.prompt: What does "Nunca voy al gimnasio" mean?
choices: I always go to the gym
I never go to the gym
I sometimes go to the gym
I want to go to the gym
questions.explanation: "Nunca" means "never". Unlike "no", "nunca" can stand directly before the verb without also needing "no".

questions.prompt: Write the question word that means "who" in Spanish.
Correct the error: "Yo como no verduras porque no me gustan."
questions.opener: "No" should be placed directly before the verb, not after.
questions.answer: Yo no como verduras porque no me gustan.
steps: "Como no verduras" has "no" in the wrong place — it should be BEFORE the verb, not after.
Correct word order: "No como verduras" (I don't eat vegetables).
"Porque no me gustan" (because I don't like them) is already correct and doesn't need to change.

questions.prompt: Which question words and negation words should you know at the grade 9 level in Spanish?
questions.opener: Asking questions and making sentences negative.
questions.answer: Question words: qué = what · quién = who · dónde = where · cuándo = when · cómo = how · por qué = why · cuántos/cuántas = how many · cuál = which. (All question words carry an accent in questions.) Negation: no + verb = not (No como carne) · nunca = never · nadie = nobody · nada = nothing · tampoco = not either. Remember: "no" is always placed directly before the verb.
